title: Crash on empty input
goal: average(xs) in src/stats.mjs throws on an empty array and returns NaN for non-numbers. It should return null for an empty array and ignore non-finite values. Make `npm test` pass.

files.src/stats.mjs: export function average(xs){ if (!xs.length) throw new Error('empty'); return xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / xs.length; }
export function average(xs){ const n = xs.filter(x => typeof x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(x)); return n.length ? n.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / n.length : null; }
